## Elder Blood Elemental (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
N Huge outsider (elemental, extraplanar, sanguine)  
**Init** +10; **Senses** bloodsense, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +19  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 15, flat-footed 17 (+6 Dex, +1 dodge, +9 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 256 (16d10+96)  
**Fort** +15; **Ref** +16; **Will** +7  
**DR** 10/–; Immune elemental traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., swim 60 ft (only in bodies of blood such as rivers of blood, lakes of blood, etc.)  
**Melee** 2 slams +23 (2d10+9 plus bleed)  
**Ranged** blood missile +20/+15 (2d6+9/x3, 70 feet, drains the blood elemental of 4 HP per attack)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** bleed (2d6), blood drain (2d6 Con), drench, engulf (Ref DC 27, blood drain), Stunning Assault (Fort DC 26)  


**Statistics**


**STR** 28, **Dex** 22, **Con** 21, **Int** 10, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 11  
**BAB** +16; **CMB** +27 (+31 bull rush); **CMD** 44 (48 vs bull rush)  
**Feats** Cleave, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Great Cleave, [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Iron Will, Stunning Assault, [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Improved Bull Rush, Improved Grapple are covered by Powerful Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative, Toughness.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +28 (+24 if jumping), Escape Artist +25, Knowledge (planes) +19, Perception +19, Stealth +21 (+29 in bodies of blood), Swim +28 (in blood only); Racial Modifiers +8 on Stealth in bodies of blood  
**SQ** blood gourmand, bloody arsenalist  
**Languages** Blood Tongue (unique to blood elementals)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any (plane of blood)  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or gang (3-8)  


**Special Abilities**


**Blood Gourmand (Ex)** Upon successfully incurring Constitution damage via their blood drain ability, a blood elemental experiences a temporary empowerment in their physical capabilities. This provides the blood elemental with a +1 bonus on attack rolls and Reflex saves, +1 dodge bonus to AC, and fast healing 1. In addition, their movement speeds increase by 5 feet.
